introduction: NGC 3351 is placed side by side in ultraviolet and visible light.
observe: Compare which parts of the ring and spiral structure become prominent in each half.
Do not treat the ultraviolet panel as a color the unaided eye could see.
explanation: The Galaxy Evolution Explorer recorded ultraviolet light, while the companion view shows the galaxy in visible light.
colorMethod: The ultraviolet data is translated into visible display colors so that an otherwise invisible wavelength range can be examined.
whyItMatters: A wavelength comparison shows that an object's appearance depends on what the detector is built to receive.
